definitions: Applicant Tracking System: Software used by recruiters and employers to manage the hiring process, including collecting, sorting, and ranking job applications.
Automatic Transfer Switch: A device that automatically switches power supply from a primary source to a backup source (e.g., generator) when the primary source fails.
examples: Many companies use an ATS to streamline their hiring.
The generator is connected to an ATS.
Your resume needs to be ATS-friendly.
The building's ATS ensures continuous power.
